title: The story at 21 mnns eerily mirrors my mallworld dreams
content: First of all, I love this channel. He dives into many different unique stories told online thru old media archives. Sometimes the stories he finds are eerily similar to specific mallworld dreams I've had. This one gave me chills. The way the story describes the intensely steep slopes in the road, to different versions of their real life familiar town, all seem like a mallworld dream for me. Specifically the extremely steep slopes in the road. So weirdly specific but something I've encountered in many of my mallworld dreams. Hell, actually a few of these stories read like mallworld dreams for me personally. It's an extremely interesting listening & I encourage other mallworld dreamers to listen to the full thing & I highly recommend this channel
